title: Reaction and Diffusion
description: Two chemicals that react and spread: Turing showed that an even mixture of them can be unstable, and paint itself into stripes. Unlocks the Pattern Basin and the Pattern Template.

puzzle.goal: An activator spreads with D and an inhibitor r times as fast, reacting at a rate k. Write the spacing L of the stripes that form, about 2π times the fourth root of r over the square root of k/D.
puzzle.name: Turing wavelength
puzzle.ask: Find L for r = @{r}, D = @{D} and k = @{k}.
puzzle.method: The fastest-growing bump is the one whose size balances spreading (D/λ²) against reaction (k): λ ∝ √(D/k).
